nextStoryContext: ReviewDispatch type is now (uuid, channel) => ReviewDispatchResult. The loop generates the channel for review via genChannel('review', uuid) before calling reviewDispatch. makeReviewDispatch in src/supervisor/review.ts is the real wiring used by next.ts. parseReviewVerdict is a pure function: returns null if no <review> tag, or { verdict, findingsCount, newStories: [] } (newStories always empty from parser; populated by makeReviewDispatch). buildReviewerWorkerArgv has no --permission-mode flag. PrdSnapshot.userStories element type now includes title, acceptanceCriteria, notes optional fields. The next story (US-009 or similar) can wire session transcript path reading or the stop-hook retirement docs.
